source_text:
22.4 ̓Εὰν γὰρ καὶ πορευθῶ ἐν μέσῳ σκιᾶς θανάτου, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι κακά. Λέγοις
δ' α ν καὶ σκιὰν θανάτου τὸν φυ σικόν τε καὶ κοινὸν θάνατον τῷ τῆς ψυχῆς θανάτῳ
διαστελλόμενον· καθὸ λέλεκται ἡ ψυχὴ ἡ ἁμαρτάνουσα ἀποθανεῖν, ὡς ὁ πισ τεύων
εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ μὴ ἀποθα νεῖται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, μεταβεβηκὼς ἀπὸ τοῦ
θανάτου εἰς τὴν ζωήν· σκιὰν γὰρ οὐχ ὑπο μένουσι θανάτου, η κινδύνους, η
σώματος λύσιν.
pass_a_gloss: If for even I-walk in midst of-shadow of-death, not I-will-fear evils. You-might-say and also shadow of-death the physical both and common death to-the of-the soul death being-distinguished; according-as it-has-been-said the soul the sinning to-die, as the believing into the son of-the God not not will-die into the age, having-passed from the death into the life; shadow for not they-undergo of-death, or dangers, or of-body dissolution.
pass_b_english: “For even if I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not fear evils” (Psalm 22:4).

You might also say that the shadow of death is the physical and common death, distinguished from the death of the soul; according as it has been said that the soul that sins shall die, as the one who believes in the Son of God will not die unto the age, having passed from death into life; for they do not undergo a shadow of death, or dangers, or dissolution of the body.

choices.term: σκιὰν θανάτου τὸν φυσικόν τε καὶ κοινὸν θάνατον τῷ τῆς ψυχῆς θανάτῳ διαστελλόμενον
choices.english: the shadow of death is the physical and common death, distinguished from the death of the soul
choices.why: σκιά is bodily/common death, not the soul’s death. OCR φυ σικόν.
rejected: the shadow of death is the soul’s death
believers still undergo the soul’s death

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
